adminHelp.title: Your organisation must approve Sentinel
adminHelp.step1: Send your IT administrator the link to this app and ask them to approve it for your organisation.
adminHelp.step2: They can grant consent in the Microsoft Entra admin centre under Enterprise applications.
adminHelp.step3: Once approved, come back here and connect again.

imap.title: Connect an IMAP account
imap.appPassword: This provider needs an app-specific password. Create one in your account's security settings and use it here.

folders.title: Folders to process
folders.hint: Sentinel only reads the folders you tick.

empty.all: No mail yet. Connect an account in Settings.

inbox.offline: You are offline. Showing what was loaded earlier.
inbox.shortcuts: Shortcuts: j / k move, Enter opens, / searches.

message.imagesBlocked: Remote images are blocked to protect your privacy.
message.attachmentsNote: Attachments are not downloaded by Sentinel. Open them in your mail app.

risk.ip_host: The address is a raw IP address.
risk.user_info: The link contains a username or password.
risk.unusual_port: The link uses an unusual port.
risk.text_mismatch: The link text says {host}, but it goes somewhere else.

ai.title: AI providers
ai.intro: Sentinel only sends mail to an AI provider after you review and allow it. Keys are stored encrypted on the server and are never shown again.

providers.name: Display name
providers.baseUrlHint: Must be https and publicly reachable.
providers.keyHint: Stored encrypted. You can replace it later but never read it back.
providers.empty: No AI provider yet. Add one to turn on summaries and drafts.

consent.title: Allow {name} to read your mail?
consent.where: If you allow this, Sentinel sends mail content to {host} so it can summarise and prioritise your mail and write draft replies.
consent.sent1: Sender, recipients, date, subject and the new text of each message (quoted history and signatures are removed).
consent.sent2: Names of attachments, never the files themselves.
consent.sent3: Your name, role, time zone and VIP senders so the AI can judge what matters.
consent.not1: Card numbers, IBANs, phone numbers and other people's email addresses are replaced before sending (you can change this in Privacy settings).
consent.not2: Mail from accounts you excluded from AI.
consent.not3: Anything at all before you allow it, and anything after you revoke.
consent.control: AI never sends email. Every reply stays a draft until you confirm it yourself.

routes.title: Task routes
routes.intro: Choose which provider and model handle each job. If the first fails, the next one is tried. Changes apply to the next request.

hint.default: Used when a job has no route of its own.
hint.triage: Runs on every new message. A small, fast model is usually enough.
hint.draft: Runs when you ask for a draft.
hint.repair: Runs only when an answer was malformed.

usage.title: Usage
usage.costCap: Cost limit per day in USD (0 = none)
usage.capHint: When a limit is reached, AI processing pauses until the next UTC day. Mail keeps syncing.
usage.priceHint: Sentinel ships no price list. Enter the prices from your provider to see costs.

bench.title: Test bench
bench.intro: Compares two models on three made-up emails. Your real mail is never used. Each run is a normal AI call: it needs consent for the provider and counts toward your usage and limits.

card.title: AI summary
card.mistakes: AI can make mistakes. Check important details.
card.byRule: Sorted by a rule, not by AI.
card.remember: Your choice is remembered for this sender.

senders.title: Important and muted senders
senders.intro: Important (VIP) senders are always treated as high importance. Muted senders are filed as low importance and never sent to AI.

actions.empty: No action items. When mail asks you to do something, it shows up here.

profile.title: Writing profile
profile.intro: This helps the AI write like you. Only these details are shared with your AI provider, and only after you have allowed it.
profile.name: Your name
profile.signatureHint: Added to the end of drafts by Sentinel, never written by the AI.

composer.intent: What do you want to say?
composer.checkHint: Highlighted parts were not in the conversation or still need your input.
composer.neverSends: Nothing is sent from here. You review and confirm every message yourself.
composer.openManually: Open the Drafts folder in your mail app to finish and send it.
